lessons_used: Home wait_info (6 wins), adoption redesigns (3 wins), finish redesigns (1 win), adoption new_flows (1 win), sign_in notifications (1 win), and finish new_screens (1 win) produced all winning tests.
Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect and frequently caused negative performance.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new_flows, home redesigns, sign_in copy, and sign_in incentives showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (e.g., adoption layout, adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path reorder, sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for major winning redesigns, reorders, and new flows.
Predictions were systematically too high for changes that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance.

lessons_next: Home wait_info (7 wins) and adoption redesigns (3 wins) reliably drove growth, while finish redesigns, adoption new_flows, sign_in notifications, and finish new_screens also produced winning tests.
Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns consistently caused negative performance across multiple tests.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new_flows, home redesigns, sign_in copy, and sign_in incentives produced no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (e.g., choose_path reorder, adoption wait_info, adoption layout, sign_in reorder, sign_in hint) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for major winning redesigns, reorders, and new flows.
Predictions were systematically too high for changes that had no clear effect or resulted in negative performance.
